subject: a metronome unfolding into rigid geometric petals
pose: petals opening around an off-center floating gear
art_direction: 木制节拍器敞开成硬边花瓣，中心悬着一枚偏心齿轮，木纹、珊瑚内面与青色影子大胆碰撞。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Transform a wooden metronome into an opening flower made of four rigid triangular panels. The panels retain walnut grain outside and coral enamel inside, while a single off-center brass gear floats where the pendulum would normally swing. Keep the base and one recognizable narrow metronome slit intact, but omit scales, numbers, or text. The panels open asymmetrically, one higher and one tucked inward, giving the machine a playful rhythmic posture. Use a pale cream background with a turquoise reflected shadow. Render small hinges, wood end grain, and the clean enamel edges carefully. The silhouette stays compact and centered, with every panel inside the circular-crop area and no loose mechanical debris.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
